business_summary: Hyundai Corporation operates as an import and export trading company in the Republic of Korea, the United States, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company distributes hot and cold rolled steel products, rear panels, coated steel sheets, steel pipes, bar and section steel, and stainless steel; aluminum, zinc, slabs, billets, blank coins, and bank note papers; gasoline, diesel oil, aircraft fuel, and sea bunkering, as well as olefin, aroma, synthetic resins, raw materials, and chemical fertilizers; and passenger and commercial vehicles, special and military vehicles, engines, and automobile parts. It also supplies equipment, parts, and signal communication systems for speed trains, subway trains, diesel cars, locomotives, passenger cars, and light rails; and supertankers, medium-sized bulk carriers, container ships, and gas tankers, as well as engages in shipbuilding financing, ship repairing and remodeling, and used ship sales. In addition, the company constructs environmental and marine, transporting and loading, and gas processing facilities, as well as power plants, petrochemical plants, oil refineries, and desalination plants; produces industrial facilities and supplies related equipment; and provides turnkey services, project financing, and offtake services. Further, it supplies electric generation systems, substation equipment, power transmission equipment, and electric supply equipment; and offers commodities, engineering, transportation, installation, and audit services. Additionally, the company invests in and operates domestic rooftop solar power plants and supplies renewable energy products, such as PV modules and inverters; distributes excavators, wheel loaders, forklifts, supplementary equipment, pumping cars, cranes, and trucks; invests in and develops energy and resources, such as coal, oil, and gas; manufactures steel; and offers management consulting services. Hyundai Corporation was founded in 1976 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: 현대종합상사는 대한민국, 미국, 아시아, 유럽 등 해외 수출입 무역회사로 활동하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 열연 및 냉연 철강 제품, 후면 패널, 도금 강판, 강관, 봉강 및 형강, 스테인리스강을 유통합니다. 알루미늄, 아연, 슬래브, 빌렛, 백지 동전 및 지폐 용지; 휘발유, 경유, 항공기유, 해상벙커링을 비롯하여 올레핀, 아로마, 합성수지, 원료, 화학비료; 승용차 및 상업용 차량, 특수 차량 및 군용 차량, 엔진 및 자동차 부품. 또한 고속 열차, 지하철, 디젤 자동차, 기관차, 승용차 및 경전철용 장비, 부품 및 신호 통신 시스템을 공급합니다. 초대형선, 중형벌크선, 컨테이너선, 가스탱커 등의 선박을 취급하고 있으며, 조선금융, 선박수리 및 개조, 중고선박 판매업도 영위하고 있습니다. 또한, 발전소, 석유화학 플랜트, 정유공장, 담수화 플랜트를 비롯하여 환경 및 해양, 운송 및 하역, 가스 처리 시설을 건설하고 있습니다. 산업시설을 생산하고 재공급
